description_en: Queries the traffic statistics of a specified Anti-DDoS Origin instance within a specified time period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内某个DDoS原生防护实例的流量统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-traffic --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w203qg0000 --ipnet 111.XX.XX.0/24 --ip 39.XX.XX.96 --start-time 1619798400 --end-time 1563445054 --interval 5 --flow-type max --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTraffic

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.


If the instance specified here is used for traffic diversion, you must set the Interval request parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID。


如果此处设置的实例用于代播防护，您必须设置请求参数Interval
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block used for traffic diversion to query
parameters.name: ipnet

parameters.help_en:
The assets that are assigned public IP addresses to query. If you do not specify this parameter in Settings, the traffic statistics of all assets that are assigned public IP addresses protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance are queried.

The assets that are assigned public IP addresses must have been added as protected objects of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118701.html to query all protected objects of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产。不设置该参数表示查询DDoS原生防护实例防护的所有公网IP资产的流量统计数据。

公网IP资产必须已经添加为DDoS原生防护实例的防护对象。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118701.html查询DDoS原生防护实例的所有防护对象
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

If you do not set this parameter, the current time is used as the end time
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。

不设置该参数表示以当前时间作为查询结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The time interval for traffic statistics. Unit: seconds. This parameter specifies the length of each interval for which traffic data is aggregated. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 设置流量统计的时间间隔，单位：秒，表示将每多少秒时间段作为一个区间，统计该区间内的流量数据。默认值为5
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The type of traffic statistics to query. Valid values:

max: the peak traffic within the statistical interval.
avg: the average traffic within the statistical interval
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的流量统计数据的类型。取值：

max：表示统计时间区间内的流量峰值。
avg：表示统计时间区间内的流量均值
parameters.name: flow_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所属地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
